approval: 用户在观测台构图轮要求将 A（观测日志）与 B（观测工作台）结合为一稿：公共骨架取两稿共有部分（夜次分组会话栏 + 划线日志流 + composer），顶部双带叠放（A 圆顶状态带 + B 观测之夜 runs 条带），A 的右缘竖向时间线标尺融入 B 的星座图——事件节点沿竖向时间刻度分布、细线连成星座路径，时间语义（UTC 时刻/顺序/预算刻度）与星座语义（权重星等/状态色/点击跳转）合为一体；C（红光联锁焦点版）落选。
structure: 结合拓扑（A×B）：顶部双带（圆顶状态带：UTC 时刻 + token 刻度尺；观测之夜 runs 条带：✓已完成/⏸已中断+↻/●运行中 chips + 全部 runs →）+ 左侧按夜次分组的观测日志会话栏（星等点阵）+ 中央划线日志式对话流（推理折叠/工具表格行/diff）+ 右侧双图框（本次观测＝时间轴星座图：事件星点沿竖向时间刻度分布、细线连星座、右缘 UTC 时刻标尺 + 底部预算刻度；测光·评分卡＝六维光度表）
prompt:
High-fidelity dark-mode desktop app UI screenshot, landscape 16:10, flat matte design, no illustration, no painterly or fantasy texture, no glow. AI coding agent app as an astronomical observatory workbench: night ground #0B1020, very faint fine graticule grid across the whole window, thin 1px rounded chart-frame borders, star-white ink #EDF1FB, single indigo accent #4D6BFE, amber #E8A33D small annotations, precise scientific tabular typography, crisp readable Chinese and English labels.

Layout:
(1) Top: two stacked thin bands spanning the full width. Band 1 dome status band: left a small dome-shutter glyph and session title 修复权限门控回归; right mono UTC timestamp 2025-08-07 16:42:11Z and token budget scale 128.7K / 200.0K with a thin indigo progress bar. Band 2 observing-nights strip: small rounded chips — green ✓ 已完成, amber ⏸ 已中断 ↻, indigo ● 运行中 — and a blue link 全部 runs → on the right.
(2) Left sidebar one-fifth width: DeepseekNova wordmark, solid indigo 新会话 button, observation log grouped under night-date headers 08-07 夜 and 08-06 夜; each entry has a small indigo star dot (three sizes for activity), a title and a mono timestamp; the active entry 修复权限门控回归 has a thin rounded indigo frame. Bottom: settings icon and a server status dot.
(3) Center: ruled logbook chat stream. A user entry labeled 你 with right-aligned mono timestamp and white text 非管理员用户仍然可以访问 /api/admin/stats，疑似门控回归. An assistant entry with model chip deepseek-v4-pro and a dim italic collapsed row ▸ 推理过程 (12s); a tool table row ⚙ shell · cargo test ✓ with green check; a monospace git diff block with red deletion lines and green addition lines; a short summary text. Bottom: thin rounded composer with ❯ prompt, placeholder 输入消息..., a model chip and a tiny mono token scale.
(4) Right panel one-quarter width with two chart-frame boxes: top box 本次观测 is an event constellation chart where indigo star dots of varying size sit along a vertical time axis with mono UTC tick labels on the right edge (16:20 to 16:50), thin hairline lines connect the dots into a constellation path, one amber annotation dot and tiny mono node labels; bottom box 测光·评分卡 is a six-row photometry table with rows 治理/验证/反思/审查/协议/综合, thin indigo horizontal bars and mono right-aligned scores, the 综合 row emphasized in indigo.
